claims.text: The hotel is a former 18th-century manor house set in a romantic park.

findings.quote: This former 18th-century manor house, nestled in a romantic park, welcomes you within its walls steeped in history.

claims.text: The hotel sits in a 12-hectare park that includes 2 hectares of walled gardens.

findings.quote: La Chenevière is nestled within a 12-hectare park, including 2 hectares of walled gardens.

claims.text: A lime-lined avenue leads to an English garden surrounding the manor house.

findings.quote: After strolling along the lime-lined avenue, you'll discover a magnificent English garden surrounding a former 18th-century manor house.

claims.text: The grounds have Cedars of Lebanon, ginkgo biloba trees and centuries-old sequoias alongside a collection of old roses.

findings.quote: Cedars of Lebanon, ginkgo biloba trees, and centuries-old sequoias stand alongside a rich collection of old roses

claims.text: Each room has its own decoration, combining old charm with modern comfort.

findings.quote: The unique decoration of each of them harmoniously combines the charm of the old and modern comfort.

claims.text: The rooms feature wood paneling and marble fireplaces.

findings.quote: The wood paneling and marble fireplaces contribute to the enchantment that only old residences can offer.

claims.text: The heated outdoor pool has a small children's pool at its end.

findings.quote: we have provided a children's pool at the end of the pool
The outdoor pool, open and heated from mid-May to mid-September, has a small children's pool.

claims.text: Guests staying at the chateau have open access to a tennis court.

findings.quote: you will discover a tennis court with open access to guests staying at the Château.

claims.text: The kitchen garden is cultivated using permaculture principles and supplies herbs, fruits and vegetables to both restaurants.

findings.quote: The kitchen garden at La Chenevière, cultivated using permaculture principles, supplies fresh herbs, fruits, and vegetables to the tables of both restaurants.

claims.text: Le Botaniste, the fine-dining restaurant in the chateau, serves cuisine inspired by nature and its garden.

findings.quote: Le Botaniste is located in the chateau and offers fine-dining cuisine inspired by nature and its garden.

claims.text: Bayeux is 10 kilometers from the hotel.

findings.quote: Located 10 kilometers from La Chenevière, the town of Bayeux is famous for its 11th-century tapestry

claims.text: La Cheneviere has its own authorized helipad, a starting point for helicopter tours over the WWII landing beaches, Arromanches, Deauville and Honfleur.

findings.quote: La Chenevière has its own authorized helipad.
it is also a stopping or starting point for helicopter tours which fly over the WWII landing beaches, the beaches at Arromanches and Deauville, the town of Honfleur

claims.text: During World War II the chateau was occupied by the Germans, and then by the Americans after the D-Day landings.

findings.quote: It was occupied by the Germans during World War II, and then the Americans after the D-Day landings before being fully restored in 1988.

claims.text: The hotel can organize guided e-bike tours of the D-Day landing beaches.

findings.quote: The hotel can organize guided e-bike tours of the landing beaches.

claims.text: The heated outdoor pool is reached by crossing the park along tree-lined paths into the walled garden.

findings.quote: To access our heated outdoor swimming pool, you will have the pleasure of crossing our park and taking one of our tree-lined paths. This picturesque route will take you to the heart of our walled garden

claims.text: The outdoor pool is open only from mid-May to mid-September, and guests are advised to contact reception for the exact dates before booking.

findings.quote: The swimming pool is generally open from mid-May to mid-September
it is best to contact our reception before booking. We will keep you informed of the exact opening and closing dates of our pool

claims.text: The hotel sits about 1 kilometer before the roundabout at Port-en-Bessin; it can arrange transfers from Bayeux station, Caen, Deauville and the Paris airports.

findings.quote: The Chenevière is 1 kilometer before the roundabout at Port-en-Bessin on the right at the bottom of a shaded driveway
The hotel organizes transfers from Paris (Charles de Gaulle and Orly airports), Caen, Deauville and Bayeux station.
